digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions Gerrit Verify workflow and CI routing
propositions: Documentation-only patchsets should execute a reduced lane containing only documentation gates (ADR validation, docs index, drift checks, quickstart validation) while skipping OS/Python matrix, mutation, optionality, artifact, eval, golden-path, and identity jobs

A trusted classifier job running only from origin/main must decide route selection by analyzing exact patchset paths against an allowlist, using HEAD^..HEAD diff with fail-closed semantics for malformed/parentless diffs, Python paths, shell paths, workflows, dependencies, tests, configuration, and unknown paths

Current inline documentation gate commands must be extracted into a single composite action (.github/actions/docs-gates/action.yml) and invoked by both full and docs-only lanes to avoid duplication and maintain single-source-of-truth for documentation validation

Classifier job failure, docs-only gate failure, or missing route must block Verified +1, while classifier failure still triggers full-route job execution as a fallback using always() && conditional gating

All workflow-structure consumers (test_gate_step_tree_skew.py, test_ci_workflow_parity.py, test_check_adr_numbers_heldout.py, and six others) must migrate to reference the extracted composite action definition without weakening existing assertions

Production routing must be verified by two live proof changes: a genuine docs-only change selecting the reduced lane with 80%+ wall-clock and runner-minute savings, and a genuine non-doc change selecting the full route with complete test suite execution
